data.title: Ireland's National Team Will Not Boycott UEFA Nations League Matches Against Israel - Telecom Asia Sport
data.content: # Ireland's National Team Will Not Boycott UEFA Nations League Matches Against Israel. **The Football Association of Ireland (FAI) has confirmed that the national team will not boycott the UEFA Nations League group stage matches against Israel for the 2026/2027 season.**. There were concerns that the "Boys in Green" might not play against Israel due to the recent events in Gaza, stemming from the escalation of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in October 2023. On June 12, the FAI announced that the match originally scheduled for October 4 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin would take place on the same day in Bačka Topola, Serbia, behind closed doors. > The association made this decision following consultation with the Republic of Ireland players who shared different views and a majority expressed that the fixtures should be played. In addition to Ireland and Israel, Group B3 of the Nations League also includes the national teams of Austria and Kosovo. Chopurov: “Yan Has Everything to Beat Dvalishvili in the Trilogy”.
